subject: English
question_text: Put the following parts of the story in correct order to
stimulus: rewrite the whole story. 1×8=8 (a) Suddenly he woke up and saw an angel. (b) Abu then requested him to put his name in the list because he loved mankind and his fellow mankind. (c) Once upon a time there was an honest and pious man. (d) In reply the angel said that his name was not there. (e) His name was Abu Ben Adhem. (f) The angel was writing the names of persons who loved God. (g) He asked the angel if his name was there. (h) He was once sleeping peacefully. R Section B : Writing Test (Marks 50)
